classification: evaluation-sheet population expansion and balance screen; no rule, class, map, objective, economy, or presentation change
authority: owner requested twenty additional distinct sheets followed by balance work, 2026-08-02
hypothesis: Twenty additional evaluation sheets can remain structurally and behaviorally distinct from one another and the twelve retained controls while producing an eligibility-clean 32-sheet counter-web without one shared-mind sheet dominating the field.

distinctnessGates.staticMetric: composition 0.28 + class/role/theater 0.36 + routes 0.12 + policies 0.10 + gambit grammar 0.14
distinctnessGates.failureDisposition: repair the sheet without outcome access or replace it; do not count a near-duplicate among the twenty

stages.population: each new sheet against Balanced, Interception, and Sustain Attrition in both participant assignments
stages.purpose: WASM faults, exact replay verification, felt degeneracy, assignment sensitivity, and outcome-blind empirical execution distance
stages.outcomeAccess: open only after all twenty pass eligibility and distinctness or have been repaired/replaced

stages.population: all 32 sheets, every unordered pair, both assignments
stages.purpose: gross balance, non-transitive counter-web, class and signature coverage, first-Pulse conversion, and full-population execution redundancy

stages.population: only pre-registered extreme or redundant rows against their strongest, weakest, and nearest-shape matchups, mirrored
stages.purpose: repair sheet competence without class-stat changes; freeze identities and disclose every revision

registeredRevisions.timing: after the first corrected-engine anchor outcome read and before any full-population screen
registeredRevisions.reason: Nineteen new sheet ids omitted the frozen audit mind's strategy keyword and therefore fell through to Balanced signature behavior. The anchor is retained as implementation-diagnosis evidence, not used for tuning or a balance verdict.
registeredRevisions.change: Bind each already-authored thesis to the closest existing audit execution style in sheetId; do not change rules, class numbers, map, cadence, composition, assignments, routes, policies, or the shared WASM artifact.
registeredRevisions.retest: Repeat the 120-cell outcome-blind anchor gate under the new sheet hashes before reading revised outcomes.

registeredRevisions.timing: after the style-corrected 120-cell anchor outcome read and before any cross-population screen
registeredRevisions.trigger: pre-registered no-zero-win guardrail; six sheets finished 0-0-6 against Balanced, Interception, and Sustain Attrition

change.breach-column: promote the centre Repulsor and north Sunder to pickup runners and enable loose-Core fallback; preserve the six-body breach axis and composition
change.centre-phalanx: promote the two outer reserves to pickup runners; preserve the central five-body protection package and composition
change.null-veil: promote the centre Switchback reserve to a third carrier; preserve smoke, suppression, and composition
change.rail-screen: send the two Lanterns to the outer Wells as pickup runners while the rails hold their firing lanes; preserve composition
change.repair-web: replace the two carrier Palisades and one duplicate Nest with a Towline, Kestrel, and one Palisade so the sustain web can actually rotate; keep two Patchbays, a Nest, Hush, and Relay
change.rotating-bastions: plant Mason/Palisade screens in both outer theaters, move the two Relays to outer carrier duty, and leave paired Switchback couriers in the centre; preserve composition

registeredRevisions.forbidden: no class-stat, rule, map, cadence, eligibility, or execution-engine change
registeredRevisions.retest: Run a mirrored targeted repair screen before cross-population outcomes; retain only eligibility-clean, behaviorally distinct revisions that no longer have zero wins.

registeredRevisions.timing: after the v3 targeted repair eligibility read and before opening its outcomes
registeredRevisions.trigger: Centre Phalanx alone tripped formation freeze in one assignment against Rotating Bastions (74 high-wait ticks in a 75-tick window)
registeredRevisions.change: Convert two of five central screen roles to intercept roles so the construction core actively contests its lane; keep the same composition, three carrier lanes, paths, policies, and fortress execution style.
registeredRevisions.retest: Repeat every targeted-repair pair involving Centre Phalanx under the v4 hash; do not alter the frozen eligibility threshold.

registeredRevisions.timing: after the eligibility-clean v3 targeted-repair outcome read and before the cross-population screen
registeredRevisions.trigger: Null Veil alone remained 0-0-6 after the first objective repair
registeredRevisions.change: Promote the two outer Veils from screen to carrier roles so their smoke accompanies actual north/south courier routes; retain Relay and Switchback as the concealed central carrier pair, both Hush interceptors, composition, policies, and sustain execution style.
registeredRevisions.retest: Repeat the same mirrored Interception, Sustain Attrition, and Repair Web target pairs under the v4 hash; retain only if eligible, distinct, and non-zero-win.

stageAmendments.timing: frozen after anchor and targeted-repair outcomes, before any cross-population outcome
stageAmendments.reason: The 992-cell exhaustive round robin is disproportionate for a provisional shared-mind screen. The corrected Release harness still costs about four wall-seconds per fully audited cell across four workers.
stageAmendments.dispositionOfFullRoundRobin: deferred, not silently replaced as product balance authority; commission only if the sparse screen leaves a decision boundary unresolved
stageAmendments.construction: One outcome-seeded circular order; pair every index at offsets +1 and +5, plus the opposite index +16. This gives every sheet two nearby-strength opponents, two broader-strength opponents, and one high/low bridge without adapting to cross-screen results.

hardGates.goldenReplayHashes: 6/6 byte-identical after any harness or engine work

balanceRead.interpretation: This diagnoses sheet-space and shared-stock-mind balance only. It cannot establish independent-lineage product balance or human enjoyment.
balanceRead.classStats: No class-stat change follows directly from sheet records; class exposure and matchup-conditioned mechanic evidence must agree before any isolated same-cohort tuning arm is registered.

forbiddenResponses: counting renamed or lightly retuned sheets as distinct
opening outcomes before anchor distinctness repairs are frozen
presenting ARS1 as the player-facing sheet UX
class-stat tuning from raw sheet win rates
